exposure: socio demographic profile (age, gravidity, residential area, socioeconomic status)
cohort: Patients admitted to the emergency department of Government General Hospital, Guntur, with postpartum haemorrhage.
finding: Atonicity was identified as the most common etiological factor (72%) for postpartum haemorrhage, with morbidity (92%) being significantly higher than mortality (8%).
mod_finding: Lscs was identified as the mode of delivery in 61% of patients presenting with postpartum haemorrhage.
